faq.q: How many minutes are in an hour?
faq.a: There are 60 minutes in 1 hour. Half an hour is 30 minutes, and a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.
asks: How long is an hour in minutes?

faq.q: How many hours are in a day?
faq.a: A day has 24 hours, which is 1,440 minutes. It is the time the Earth takes to spin round once.

faq.q: How many seconds are in a minute?
faq.a: There are 60 seconds in 1 minute. Counting slowly, one elephant, two elephants, up to 60 takes about a minute.

faq.q: How long is a football match?
faq.a: A professional football match has two halves of 45 minutes, so 90 minutes of play, plus a break at half time.
asks: How many minutes is a football match?

faq.q: How do I change hours into minutes?
faq.a: Multiply the hours by 60. 2 hours is 2 times 60, which is 120 minutes.

facts: 1 minute = 60 seconds, 1 hour = 60 minutes, and 1 day = 24 hours.
A professional football match has two 45-minute halves.

quiz.say: How many minutes are in 2 hours?
quiz.show: How many minutes are in 2 hours?
quiz.why: Each hour is 60 minutes, so 2 hours is 60 plus 60, which is 120.

wrong.2: 200 treats an hour as 100 minutes, but it is 60.

quiz.why: 1 day is 24 hours, more than 20 hours, and it is 1,440 minutes, more than 1,000.

wrong.0: 20 hours is 4 hours less than a day.
wrong.2: 1,000 minutes is under 17 hours, less than a day.
